attempts.final_prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: production desktop application icon source, exactly 1024x1024
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target from the previous attempt
Primary request: Change only the output encoding/background boundary. Remove the external background around the existing rounded charcoal icon silhouette and make those outside pixels genuinely transparent in the PNG alpha channel. Preserve every visible pixel of the C03 robot composition, silhouette, orange outline, cream double-arrow eyes, lightning, proportions, crop, color, shading, and edge shape unchanged. Scale the complete existing composition proportionally to a 1024x1024 canvas without redesigning it.
Constraints: return a real RGBA PNG with alpha, exactly 1024x1024; all four corner pixels alpha 0; natural anti-aliased alpha edge; no checkerboard baked into RGB; no opaque square; no text; no watermark; no added or removed object; no creative changes
Avoid: any change except genuine background transparency and exact canvas size

image_generation.selected_output_inspection: The selected ImageGen file is 1254x1254 RGB without usable alpha, so it was used only as the visual raster source.
image_generation.alpha_reconstruction: Derived the closed foreground silhouette per scanline from the selected source's dark or chromatic foreground extents, discarded every exterior pixel including boundary-connected neutral checkerboard and anti-alias contamination, applied a 0.7 sigma alpha blur, normalized partial-alpha edge RGB to charcoal, resized to a 960x960 safe area, and inset it by 32 transparent pixels on the 1024 canvas.

source_asset.metadata: 1024x1024, 16-bit RGBA, embedded sRGB ICC, four corners and complete outer 32-pixel boundary alpha 0
